How similar would it sound to the real thing? Obviously there would be some differences, but would the supporting instruments have similar patterns.

The drums would be very similar. Early rock/blues drumming isn't very challenging. You just keep time while putting the accents on the second and fourth beats of every measure. The drummer would just play that pattern over and over again until the end of the song. I'm not a drummer, but I bet if you asked a hundred drummer to play a rock (or uptempo blues - same thing) beat they would all play very similar patterns. You also have to remember rock and roll was a newborn baby in 1955 and not very sophisticated.
